steps.en: Run a one-shot audit at the project root
steps.zh: 在项目根目录跑一次审计

steps.en: Scans deterministically for state & effects, performance, architecture, security, a11y, maintainability issues
steps.zh: 对 state/effect、性能、架构、安全、可访问性、可维护性做确定性扫描

steps.en: Install the rule set as a skill your coding agent reads
steps.zh: 把规则集装成 agent 会读的 skill

steps.en: Gate every pull request with one command
steps.zh: 一条命令给每个 PR 设闸门

steps.en: Reviews each PR and reports only the issues your change introduced
steps.zh: 逐 PR 扫描，只报告本次改动引入的问题

value.en: One React rule set the agent learns from, your editor enforces, and CI gates on — same input, same findings, every run
value.zh: 一套 React 规则贯穿 agent 自学、编辑器与 CI 闸门——同样输入，永远同样结论

sources: README.md main @ 2026-09 (Install for agents): npx react-doctor@latest install
README.md main @ 2026-09 (Run in CI): npx react-doctor@latest ci install; 'reviews every pull request and reports only the issues your change introduced'
README.md headline @ 2026-09: 'finds issues across state and effects, performance, architecture, security, accessibility, and maintainability'
